summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 6 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: China Sought Access to Anthropic’s Newest A.I. The Answer Was No.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
